meta.name: add-gchat
meta.description: Add Google Chat channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 通过 Chat SDK 为应用接入 Google Chat 渠道。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发应用并想让它能收发 Google Chat 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Add Google Chat integration to your app via the Chat SDK.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app and need Google Chat messaging.

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 加上 Google Chat 渠道:从 channels 分支复制 gchat 适配器和它的注册测试到 src/channels/,在渠道入口追加一行注册 import,安装固定版本依赖包,然后构建并跑那条注册测试。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 接入 Google Chat 渠道时触发;流程走完会提示回到 /setup,否则运行 /manage-channels 把该渠道接到某个 agent group。

say.text: 帮我把 Google Chat 渠道加到 NanoClaw 里
say.note: 执行 Apply 各步并跑注册测试

howto.what_en: Adds a Google Chat channel to NanoClaw: copies the gchat adapter and its registration test from the channels branch into src/channels/, appends a one-line registration import to the channel barrel, installs a pinned adapter package, then builds and runs the registration test.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a Google Chat channel to NanoClaw. After it finishes, return to /setup if you're mid-setup; otherwise run /manage-channels to wire the channel to an agent group.

say_en.text: Add the Google Chat channel to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Runs the Apply steps and the registration test
Red means the import or the dependency drifted

say_en.text: Use /manage-channels to wire gchat to an agent group
say_en.note: Binds the channel to one agent group
